Views the code of a specified version.

<span id="limits"></span>
## Limits

Request rate limit: Maximum 20 requests per second.

<span id="usage"></span>
## Usage


* Request Method: GET

* Request URL: https://cdn.byteplusapi.com?Action=GetSnapshot&Version=2021\-03\-01


<span id="request-parameters"></span>
## Request parameters

<span id="query"></span>
### Query


|Parameter |Type |Required |Description |
|---|---|---|---|
|Action |String |Yes |API name. The name of the current API is `GetSnapshot`. |
|Version |String |Yes |API version. The version of the current API is `2021-03-01`. |
|FunctionId |String |Yes |Function ID. You can call [ListFunction](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/byteplus-cdn/edge-functions-api-ref-ListFunction-en) to get the function ID. |
|VersionTag |String |Yes |Version number. You can get the version number by calling the [ListVersions](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/byteplus-cdn/edge-functions-api-ref-ListVersions-en) API. |


<span id="response-parameters"></span>
## Response parameters


|Parameter |Type |Description |Example value |
|---|---|---|---|
|SourceCode |String |Function code. | |
|script_type |String |Script type. |`js` |
|source |String |Code content. The code is converted to Base64 encoding format. |`` |
|Config |String |Function configuration. | |
|config |JSONMap |Function configuration. | |


<span id="example"></span>
## Example

<span id="request-example"></span>
### Request example

```HTTP
GET  https://cdn.byteplusapi.com?Action=GetSnapshot&Version=2021-03-01&FunctionId=3gyz993****&VersionTag=1.0.1
```


<span id="response-example"></span>
### Response example

```json
{
    "ResponseMetadata": {
        "RequestId": "2022021014244901022524313903*****",
        "Action": "GetSnapshot",
        "Version": "2021-03-01",
        "Service": "CDN",
        "Region": "ap-singapore-1"
    },
    "Result": {
        "SourceCode": "{\"script_type\":\"js\",\"source\":\"\"}",
        "Config": "{\"config\":{},\"env\":{\"js\":{\"default\":{\"wer\":\"wer\"}}}}"
    }
}
```
